blocks.zh: 採購管制、生產管制、可追溯性與量測設備管制
blocks.en: Purchasing Control, Production Control, Traceability, and Control of Monitoring and Measuring Equipment

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 7.4.1 供應商評鑑的「風險比例」原則：不同風險等級的採購品需要不同的供應商管制強度
blocks.en: Understand the risk-proportionate principle of supplier evaluation in 7.4.1: purchased products of different risk levels require different degrees of supplier control

blocks.zh: 掌握 7.5.5 無菌醫療器材的特定要求：連結至滅菌製程驗證（7.5.7）及相關外部標準（ISO 11607、ISO 17665 等）
blocks.en: Master the specific requirements for sterile medical devices in 7.5.5: the link to sterilization process validation (7.5.7) and related external standards (ISO 11607, ISO 17665, etc.)

blocks.zh: 理解 7.5.6 特殊製程驗證的範疇：哪些製程被視為「特殊製程」，需要額外的驗證義務
blocks.en: Understand the scope of special process validation in 7.5.6: which processes are regarded as "special processes" and carry additional validation obligations

blocks.zh: 掌握 7.5.7 滅菌及無菌屏障系統驗證的再驗證觸發條件
blocks.en: Master the revalidation triggers for validation of sterilization and sterile barrier systems in 7.5.7

blocks.zh: 理解 7.5.9 可追溯性要求：植入式器材的強化追溯義務與 CDMO 記錄保存實務
blocks.en: Understand the traceability requirements of 7.5.9: the enhanced traceability obligations for implantable devices and record retention practice at a CDMO

blocks.zh: 了解 7.6 量測設備管制：校正失效時的回溯評估義務，以及監控軟體的驗證要求
blocks.en: Understand the control of monitoring and measuring equipment in 7.6: the obligation to assess previous results when calibration fails, and the validation requirements for monitoring software

blocks.zh: Clause 7.4: Purchasing — 採購管制
blocks.en: Clause 7.4: Purchasing

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 7.4.2 的「變更通知協議」：供應商管理的關鍵保障
blocks.en: The "change notification agreement" in 7.4.2: a key safeguard in supplier management

blocks.zh: 7.4.2 要求採購文件中包含供應商變更通知書面協議（Change Notification Agreement），這在實務中通常以品質技術協議（Quality Technical Agreement, QTA）的形式落實。
blocks.en: 7.4.2 requires purchasing documents to include a written agreement on supplier change notification (Change Notification Agreement), which in practice is usually implemented as a Quality Technical Agreement (QTA).

blocks.zh: QTA 應明確規定：
blocks.en: The QTA should clearly specify:

blocks.zh: 哪些類型的變更需要提前通知（原材料、製程、設施、人員、檢測方法等）
blocks.en: Which types of change require advance notification (raw materials, processes, facilities, personnel, test methods, etc.)

blocks.zh: 通知時間窗口（通常 30–90 天前）
blocks.en: The notification window (usually 30–90 days in advance)

blocks.zh: CDMO/客戶的評估與核准流程
blocks.en: The CDMO's/customer's evaluation and approval process

blocks.zh: 未通知變更的後果（拒收、CAPA 要求）
blocks.en: The consequences of unnotified changes (rejection, CAPA requirements)

blocks.zh: 若供應商未依協議通知變更而導致產品不符合，7.4.2 提供了 CDMO 追溯責任的法規基礎。
blocks.en: If a supplier fails to notify a change as agreed and the product is nonconforming as a result, 7.4.2 provides the regulatory basis for the CDMO to hold the supplier accountable.

blocks.zh: 類比說明：7.4.3 進貨驗收的風險比例邏輯
blocks.en: Analogy: the risk-proportionate logic of incoming inspection under 7.4.3

blocks.zh: 進貨驗收強度應與風險成比例，就像機場安全管制：商務旅客（低風險）使用快速通道；初次旅客（未知風險）接受標準安檢；被標記旅客（已知風險）接受加強檢查。對績效良好的關鍵供應商，可適當減少進貨抽驗頻率；對新供應商或有歷史問題的供應商，則應加強每批驗收，這正是 ISO 13485 7.4.3 所授權的風險比例方法。
blocks.en: The intensity of incoming inspection should be proportionate to risk, like airport security: business travelers (low risk) use the fast lane; first-time travelers (unknown risk) go through standard screening; flagged travelers (known risk) receive enhanced checks. For a critical supplier with good performance, the frequency of incoming sampling inspection can reasonably be reduced; for a new supplier or one with a history of problems, every lot should be inspected more strictly. This is exactly the risk-proportionate approach that ISO 13485 7.4.3 authorizes.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: CDMO 的玻璃注射器供應商通知將更換玻璃管材原料供應商，但未更改尺寸規格。依據 7.4.2 和 7.4.3，CDMO 應採取哪些行動？是否需要重新進行 E&L 研究？
blocks.en: A CDMO's glass syringe supplier notifies it that it will change the supplier of the raw glass tubing, with no change to the dimensional specifications. Under 7.4.2 and 7.4.3, what actions should the CDMO take? Does the E&L study need to be repeated?

blocks.zh: 您的供應商評估程序中，如何定義「關鍵供應商」？請列出三項判定標準，並說明與 7.4.1(c) 和 (d) 的對應關係。
blocks.en: How does your supplier evaluation procedure define a "critical supplier"? List three criteria and explain how they correspond to 7.4.1(c) and (d).

blocks.zh: 概念解析：7.4.1 的「風險比例」原則 — 分級供應商管理的法規依據
blocks.en: Concept: the "risk-proportionate" principle of 7.4.1 - the regulatory basis for tiered supplier management

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 在 7.4.1 明確要求評鑑標準「與醫療器材相關風險成比例」，這直接支持業界廣泛採用的分級供應商管理（Tiered Supplier Management）體系：
blocks.en: ISO 13485 7.4.1 explicitly requires that evaluation criteria be "proportionate to the risk associated with the medical device", which directly supports the Tiered Supplier Management system widely adopted in industry:

blocks.zh: 7.4.1 同時要求「非履行採購要求」的處理也需與風險成比例——對關鍵供應商的重大不符合，可能觸發供應商暫停或取消資格。
blocks.en: 7.4.1 also requires that the handling of "nonfulfillment of purchasing requirements" be proportionate to risk: a major nonconformance by a critical supplier may trigger suspension or disqualification of the supplier.

blocks.zh: Clause 7.5.1–7.5.5: Production Control & Sterile Medical Device Requirements — 生產管制與無菌器材要求
blocks.en: Clause 7.5.1–7.5.5: Production Control & Sterile Medical Device Requirements

blocks.zh: 概念解析：7.5.1 批次記錄（Batch Record）的法規定義
blocks.en: Concept: the regulatory definition of the batch record under 7.5.1

blocks.zh: 7.5.1 要求每個醫療器材或批次都必須有記錄，提供：
blocks.en: 7.5.1 requires a record for each medical device or batch of medical devices that provides:

blocks.zh: 可追溯性（至 7.5.9 定義的範圍）
blocks.en: Traceability (to the extent defined in 7.5.9)

blocks.zh: 生產數量識別
blocks.en: Identification of the quantity manufactured

blocks.zh: 核准放行數量識別
blocks.en: Identification of the quantity approved for distribution

blocks.zh: 已驗證並核准的狀態
blocks.en: Verification and approval status

blocks.zh: 這就是 Device History Record（DHR）的法規依據——FDA 21 CFR 820.184 對此有完全相同的要求。DHR 是生產歷史的完整記錄，包含所有批次相關的製造、測試、放行記錄。
blocks.en: This is the regulatory basis for the Device History Record (DHR); FDA 21 CFR 820.184 has an identical requirement. The DHR is the complete record of production history, including all manufacturing, testing, and release records related to the batch.

blocks.zh: 7.5.5 無菌醫療器材特定要求：CDMO 最核心的條款
blocks.en: 7.5.5 Particular requirements for sterile medical devices: the most central clause for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 7.5.5 雖然文字簡短，卻是無菌 CDMO 最關鍵的條款：
blocks.en: Although the wording of 7.5.5 is brief, it is the most critical clause for a sterile CDMO:

blocks.zh: 每批滅菌記錄：必須保存每次滅菌批次的製程參數（溫度、時間、壓力、F₀ 值等）
blocks.en: Sterilization records for each batch: the process parameters of every sterilization batch (temperature, time, pressure, F₀ value, etc.) must be retained

blocks.zh: 雙向可追溯性：滅菌記錄必須能追溯到對應的醫療器材生產批次（由滅菌記錄找到哪些產品批次被滅菌；由產品批次找到對應的滅菌記錄）
blocks.en: Two-way traceability: sterilization records must be traceable to the corresponding production batches of medical devices (from the sterilization record, find which product batches were sterilized; from the product batch, find the corresponding sterilization record)

blocks.zh: 與 7.5.7 的連結：製程參數記錄需與已驗證的製程參數範圍比對——這是滅菌放行的法規依據
blocks.en: Link to 7.5.7: the recorded process parameters must be compared against the validated process parameter ranges, which is the regulatory basis for sterilization release

blocks.zh: 對使用 EO（環氧乙烷）或 Steam（蒸汽）滅菌的 CDMO：批次記錄必須連結 ISO 11135（EO）或 ISO 17665（Steam/Moist Heat）驗證的已核准製程參數範圍。
blocks.en: For a CDMO using EO (ethylene oxide) or steam sterilization: the batch record must be linked to the approved process parameter ranges validated under ISO 11135 (EO) or ISO 17665 (steam/moist heat).

blocks.zh: 類比說明：7.5.2 產品潔淨度要求的觸發條件
blocks.en: Analogy: the triggers for product cleanliness requirements under 7.5.2

blocks.zh: 7.5.2 的五個觸發條件覆蓋了所有「潔淨度有意義」的情境：想像一家外科器械 CDMO——(a) 器械製造後由 CDMO 清洗再滅菌；(b) 客戶提供未清洗的零件由 CDMO 清洗後滅菌；(c) 某零件無法清洗但其微粒污染水平影響最終使用（如某些精密光學元件）；(d) 非無菌器材的清潔狀態仍有臨床意義（如牙科器械）；(e) 製程中使用切削液需在成品前去除。每種情境都需要書面的潔淨度要求文件。
blocks.en: The five triggers in 7.5.2 cover all situations in which cleanliness is meaningful. Imagine a surgical instrument CDMO: (a) a device is cleaned by the CDMO after manufacture and then sterilized; (b) the customer supplies uncleaned parts that the CDMO cleans before sterilization; (c) a part cannot be cleaned, but its level of particulate contamination affects final use (such as some precision optical components); (d) the cleanliness of a non-sterile device still has clinical significance (such as dental instruments); (e) cutting fluids are used in processing and must be removed before the finished product. Each situation requires documented cleanliness requirements.

blocks.zh: Clause 7.5.6–7.5.7: Validation of Special Processes & Sterilization — 特殊製程驗證與滅菌確效
blocks.en: Clause 7.5.6–7.5.7: Validation of Special Processes & Sterilization

blocks.zh: 7.5.7 滅菌及無菌屏障驗證的再驗證觸發條件
blocks.en: Revalidation triggers for validation of sterilization and sterile barrier systems under 7.5.7

blocks.zh: 7.5.7 要求「實施前」及「產品或製程變更後（適當情況下）」進行驗證。業界根據此要求定義再驗證觸發事件（Revalidation Triggers）：
blocks.en: 7.5.7 requires validation "prior to implementation" and "following changes to the product or process, where appropriate". Based on this requirement, industry defines revalidation triggers:

blocks.zh: 產品變更：包材尺寸/材質改變、產品密度/負荷改變、初始生物負荷基準變化
blocks.en: Product changes: change in packaging size/material, change in product density/load, change in the initial bioburden baseline

blocks.zh: 製程變更：滅菌週期參數修改、負荷配置改變、設備重大修繕後
blocks.en: Process changes: modification of sterilization cycle parameters, change in load configuration, after major equipment repair

blocks.zh: 設備變更：滅菌設備更換、腔室重大零件更換
blocks.en: Equipment changes: replacement of the sterilizer, replacement of major chamber components

blocks.zh: 設施變更：滅菌間遷移、倉儲條件改變影響無菌屏障完整性
blocks.en: Facility changes: relocation of the sterilization area, changes in storage conditions that affect sterile barrier integrity

blocks.zh: 定期再驗證：通常每年一次，確認製程仍在已驗證狀態
blocks.en: Periodic revalidation: usually once a year, to confirm the process remains in a validated state

blocks.zh: 無菌屏障系統驗證（ISO 11607-2）與滅菌製程驗證並列要求，意味著包材的密封完整性驗證也是 7.5.7 的範疇。
blocks.en: Validation of sterile barrier systems (ISO 11607-2) is required alongside sterilization process validation, which means seal integrity validation of the packaging materials also falls within the scope of 7.5.7.

blocks.zh: 7.5.6 製程電腦軟體驗證：被低估的要求
blocks.en: 7.5.6 Validation of process computer software: an underestimated requirement

blocks.zh: 7.5.6 最後兩段對「生產和服務提供中使用的電腦軟體」有明確的驗證要求：
blocks.en: The last two paragraphs of 7.5.6 set out explicit validation requirements for "computer software used in production and service provision":

blocks.zh: 初次使用前必須驗證
blocks.en: Must be validated before initial use

blocks.zh: 軟體或應用方式變更後適當情況下再驗證
blocks.en: Revalidated where appropriate after changes to the software or its application

blocks.zh: 驗證範圍與風險成比例
blocks.en: The scope of validation is proportionate to risk

blocks.zh: 涵蓋範圍：充填機 PLC/SCADA 系統、環境監控軟體（EM 系統）、檢驗設備軟體（顆粒計數器、TOC 分析儀）、ERP/MES 中影響批次記錄的模組。這些不是「IT 系統」問題，而是直接的 GMP 合規要求。
blocks.en: Scope covers: filling machine PLC/SCADA systems, environmental monitoring software (EM systems), inspection equipment software (particle counters, TOC analyzers), and modules of ERP/MES that affect batch records. These are not "IT system" issues but direct GMP compliance requirements.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的主要客戶將其注射器從 1mL 改為 2.25mL 規格（同材質，但容積更大）。依據 7.5.7，CDMO 的 EO 滅菌製程是否需要重新驗證？哪些參數最可能需要重新評估（提示：考慮包裝尺寸與氣體穿透）？
blocks.en: A CDMO's main customer changes its syringe from 1 mL to 2.25 mL (same material, but larger volume). Under 7.5.7, does the CDMO's EO sterilization process need to be revalidated? Which parameters are most likely to need reassessment (hint: consider package size and gas penetration)?

blocks.zh: 您的無菌灌裝線更新了 SCADA 系統的一個模組，該模組負責記錄灌裝重量數據並生成批次報告。依據 7.5.6，這是否需要軟體再驗證？應驗證哪些功能？
blocks.en: Your aseptic filling line has updated a module of the SCADA system that records fill weight data and generates batch reports. Under 7.5.6, does this require software revalidation? Which functions should be validated?

blocks.zh: 概念解析：7.5.6 特殊製程 — 哪些製程必須驗證？
blocks.en: Concept: 7.5.6 special processes - which processes must be validated?

blocks.zh: 7.5.6 的核心定義：「輸出無法或未以後續監控或量測驗證」的製程即為特殊製程（Special Process），必須進行製程驗證。無菌醫療器材製造中的特殊製程包括：
blocks.en: The core definition in 7.5.6: a process whose "resulting output cannot be or is not verified by subsequent monitoring or measurement" is a special process (Special Process) and must be validated. Special processes in sterile medical device manufacturing include:

blocks.zh: 7.5.6 的驗證文件體系（IQ → OQ → PQ）是對應要求 (b)（設備鑑定）+ (c)（方法與接受標準）+ (f)（再驗證準則）的直接實踐。
blocks.en: The validation documentation system of 7.5.6 (IQ → OQ → PQ) is the direct implementation of requirement (b) (qualification of equipment) + (c) (methods and acceptance criteria) + (f) (criteria for revalidation).

blocks.zh: Clause 7.5.8–7.5.11: Identification, Traceability, Customer Property & Preservation Clause 7.5.8–7.5.11：識別、追溯性、顧客財產與防護
blocks.en: Clause 7.5.8–7.5.11: Identification, Traceability, Customer Property & Preservation

blocks.zh: 7.5.8 UDI（唯一設備識別碼）的合規要求
blocks.en: Compliance requirements for UDI (Unique Device Identification) under 7.5.8

blocks.zh: 7.5.8 提到「如法規要求，應建立 UDI 系統」。目前主要法規要求：
blocks.en: 7.5.8 states that "a system of Unique Device Identification shall be established where required by regulation". The main current regulatory requirements are:

blocks.zh: EU MDR 2017/745：所有 Class I 以上的醫療器材均需 UDI，已階段性強制實施
blocks.en: EU MDR 2017/745: UDI is required for all devices above Class I, with phased mandatory implementation

blocks.zh: FDA 21 CFR Part 830：已強制實施，Class III 最先，向下延伸至 Class I
blocks.en: FDA 21 CFR Part 830: mandatory, starting with Class III and extending down to Class I

blocks.zh: 中國 NMPA：已實施醫療器材唯一標識制度
blocks.en: China NMPA: a unique device identification system for medical devices has been implemented

blocks.zh: CDMO 的合規義務：確認每件產品的標籤包含正確的 UDI（Device Identifier + Production Identifier），並將 UDI 資訊納入 DHR 批次記錄。
blocks.en: CDMO compliance obligation: confirm that the label of each product carries the correct UDI (Device Identifier + Production Identifier), and include the UDI information in the DHR batch record.

blocks.zh: 7.5.10 客戶財產：CDMO 的重要責任條款
blocks.en: 7.5.10 Customer property: a key responsibility clause for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，「客戶財產（Customer Property）」通常包括：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, "customer property" typically includes:

blocks.zh: 客戶提供的初級包材（如客戶採購的預填充注射器）
blocks.en: Primary packaging components supplied by the customer (such as prefilled syringes purchased by the customer)

blocks.zh: 客戶提供的標籤設計文件與電子檔案
blocks.en: Label design documents and electronic files supplied by the customer

blocks.zh: 客戶的技術秘密（如配方、製程參數）
blocks.en: The customer's proprietary know-how (such as formulations and process parameters)

blocks.zh: 客戶提供的設備或模具
blocks.en: Equipment or tooling supplied by the customer

blocks.zh: 7.5.10 要求：識別、驗收確認、保護、防護，若損失或損壞則立即通知並記錄。這是 CDMO 服務合約中「客戶財產管理條款」的法規基礎。
blocks.en: 7.5.10 requires identification, verification, protection, and safeguarding, and, if lost or damaged, immediate notification and recording. This is the regulatory basis for the "customer property management" clause in CDMO service contracts.

blocks.zh: 類比說明：7.5.11 保存要求延伸至「構成部件」的意義
blocks.en: Analogy: why 7.5.11 extends preservation requirements to "constituent parts"

blocks.zh: 7.5.11 特別規定保存要求適用於醫療器材的「構成部件（Constituent Parts）」，不只是成品。這就像一個精密機械錶的製造：不僅錶本身需要防潮儲存，製造過程中等待組裝的齒輪、彈片、水晶玻璃都需要在適當條件下保存。對無菌充填 CDMO，這意味著：等待充填的無菌初級包材、已充填未滅菌的產品、已滅菌但未最終包裝的產品，每個階段都有其保存要求，且必須被文件化和監控。
blocks.en: 7.5.11 specifically provides that preservation requirements apply to the "constituent parts" of a medical device, not only the finished product. This is like making a precision mechanical watch: not only the finished watch needs moisture-proof storage, but also the gears, springs, and crystal glass waiting for assembly must be kept under appropriate conditions. For a sterile filling CDMO, this means that sterile primary packaging components awaiting filling, filled but unsterilized product, and sterilized but not yet finally packaged product each have their own preservation requirements, which must be documented and monitored.

blocks.zh: 客戶委託 CDMO 生產一批植入式骨釘（植入式器材）。依據 7.5.9.2，CDMO 的批次記錄中必須包含哪些環境條件記錄？若加工時潔淨室 EM 記錄顯示有一筆超標數據，應如何處理？
blocks.en: A customer commissions a CDMO to produce a batch of implantable bone screws (implantable devices). Under 7.5.9.2, which environmental condition records must the CDMO's batch record contain? If the cleanroom EM records during processing show an out-of-limit result, how should it be handled?

blocks.zh: CDMO 倉庫中客戶提供的 500 個玻璃瓶在搬運時有 10 個破損。依據 7.5.10，CDMO 的正確做法是什麼？應保存哪些記錄？
blocks.en: In a CDMO warehouse, 10 of the 500 glass vials supplied by the customer were broken during handling. Under 7.5.10, what is the CDMO's correct course of action? Which records should be retained?

blocks.zh: 概念解析：7.5.9 可追溯性要求 — ISO 13485 vs. ISO 9001 的關鍵差異
blocks.en: Concept: 7.5.9 traceability requirements - the key difference between ISO 13485 and ISO 9001

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 的追溯性要求明顯強於 ISO 9001：
blocks.en: The traceability requirements of ISO 13485 are markedly stronger than those of ISO 9001:

blocks.zh: 對植入式醫療器材（如骨科植入物、心臟支架等）：CDMO 的批次記錄必須包含每個組件的批號、每種材料的規格與批號、生產時的環境條件（溫度、濕度、潔淨度記錄）。
blocks.en: For implantable medical devices (such as orthopedic implants and cardiac stents): the CDMO's batch record must include the lot number of each component, the specification and lot number of each material, and the environmental conditions during production (temperature, humidity, and cleanliness records).

blocks.zh: Clause 7.6: Control of Monitoring and Measuring Equipment — 監控與量測設備管制
blocks.en: Clause 7.6: Control of Monitoring and Measuring Equipment

blocks.zh: 概念解析：校正失效時的「回溯評估」義務
blocks.en: Concept: the obligation to assess previous results when calibration fails

blocks.zh: 7.6 中最具法規影響力的要求是：當量測設備被發現不符合要求時，必須評估並記錄先前量測結果的有效性。
blocks.en: The requirement of greatest regulatory impact in 7.6 is: when measuring equipment is found not to conform to requirements, the validity of the previous measuring results must be assessed and recorded.

blocks.zh: 這意味著：若一台充填重量秤的最近一次校正發現已超出容許誤差，CDMO 必須：
blocks.en: This means that if the most recent calibration of a fill-weight balance shows it was out of tolerance, the CDMO must:

blocks.zh: 確定上次校正合格的時間點
blocks.en: Determine the point in time of the last acceptable calibration

blocks.zh: 評估兩次校正間隔期間所有使用該設備的批次
blocks.en: Assess all batches in which the equipment was used between the two calibrations

blocks.zh: 判定受影響批次的量測結果是否仍可信
blocks.en: Determine whether the measurement results of the affected batches are still reliable

blocks.zh: 若量測結果失效 → 可能觸發批次調查、額外測試、甚至召回評估
blocks.en: If the measurement results are invalid → this may trigger a batch investigation, additional testing, or even a recall assessment

blocks.zh: 這是 GMP 中「設備可疑狀態（Equipment Out-of-Tolerance）」事件處理的法規依據，必須以 CAPA 或偏差調查文件化。
blocks.en: This is the regulatory basis for handling "Equipment Out-of-Tolerance" events in GMP, which must be documented through a CAPA or deviation investigation.

blocks.zh: 類比說明：校正追溯與「可疑批次」評估
blocks.en: Analogy: calibration traceability and the assessment of "suspect batches"

blocks.zh: 想像一家每天使用體重秤測量食品重量的工廠。如果某天發現秤少稱了 5%（超出容許誤差），必須追問：「這台秤上次合格校正是什麼時候？上次合格到發現失效之間，有多少批產品用這台秤放行了？」這些產品的重量記錄現在需要被質疑。醫療器材的量測設備失效處理完全相同——而且後果更嚴重，因為量測結果直接關係到患者安全。7.6 要求的「回溯評估」正是確保品質系統能發現並糾正這類漏網之魚。
blocks.en: Imagine a factory that uses a scale every day to weigh food. If one day the scale is found to be under-weighing by 5% (outside tolerance), the questions must be asked: "When was this scale last calibrated and found acceptable? Between that acceptable calibration and the discovery of the failure, how many batches of product were released using this scale?" The weight records of those products now come into question. Handling a measuring equipment failure for medical devices is exactly the same, and the consequences are more serious because measurement results bear directly on patient safety. The "assessment of previous results" required by 7.6 is exactly what ensures the quality system can detect and correct this kind of escape.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的 TOC（總有機碳）分析儀在季度校正中被發現超出規格。這台設備過去三個月用於放行清潔驗證樣本。依據 7.6，CDMO 應採取哪些步驟？哪些批次記錄需要被審查？
blocks.en: A CDMO's TOC (total organic carbon) analyzer is found out of specification at its quarterly calibration. The instrument was used over the past three months to release cleaning validation samples. Under 7.6, what steps should the CDMO take? Which batch records need to be reviewed?

blocks.zh: 您的 EM（環境監控）系統軟體供應商發布了一個更新，修正了數據顯示的 bug（顯示邏輯變更，但數據採集功能未變）。依據 7.6，是否需要再驗證？驗證範圍應包含哪些測試？
blocks.en: The software vendor of your EM (environmental monitoring) system releases an update that fixes a data display bug (the display logic changes, but the data acquisition function does not). Under 7.6, is revalidation required? Which tests should the validation scope include?

blocks.zh: 新採購的粒子計數器附帶製造商的出廠校正證書，校正可追溯至 NIST 標準。CDMO 是否可以直接使用，還是需要在使用前進行額外的設備鑑定？請說明依據。
blocks.en: A newly purchased particle counter comes with the manufacturer's factory calibration certificate, with calibration traceable to NIST standards. Can the CDMO use it directly, or is additional equipment qualification required before use? Explain the basis.

blocks.zh: 7.6 量測軟體驗證：與 7.5.6 的區別
blocks.en: 7.6 Validation of measurement software: how it differs from 7.5.6

blocks.zh: 7.5.6 要求驗證「生產製程用軟體」；7.6 要求驗證「監控與量測用軟體」。兩者範疇不同：
blocks.en: 7.5.6 requires validation of "software used for production processes"; 7.6 requires validation of "software used for monitoring and measurement". The two have different scopes:

blocks.zh: 7.6 的軟體驗證重點是：確保軟體輸出的量測數據是準確、完整且不可偽造的。LIMS（實驗室資訊管理系統）是最典型的 7.6 驗證對象。
blocks.en: The focus of software validation under 7.6 is to ensure that the measurement data output by the software is accurate, complete, and tamper-proof. LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System) is the most typical subject of 7.6 validation.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 7.4.1 分級供應商管理有法規依據：「與風險成比例」的評鑑標準明確授權分級管理；QTA 中的供應商變更通知義務（7.4.2）是防止未申報變更損害產品品質的關鍵保障
blocks.en: Tiered supplier management under 7.4.1 has a regulatory basis: evaluation criteria "proportionate to risk" explicitly authorize tiered management; the supplier change notification obligation in the QTA (7.4.2) is a key safeguard against unreported changes harming product quality

blocks.zh: 7.5.5 是無菌 CDMO 的核心義務：每批滅菌記錄必須保存，且可雙向追溯至對應的醫療器材生產批次——這是滅菌批次放行的直接法規依據
blocks.en: 7.5.5 is the core obligation for a sterile CDMO: sterilization records for each batch must be retained and be traceable in both directions to the corresponding medical device production batches, which is the direct regulatory basis for sterilization batch release

blocks.zh: 7.5.6 特殊製程驗證範圍廣泛：涵蓋滅菌、無菌灌裝、焊接、密封等輸出無法完全驗證的製程；製程電腦軟體也在此要求範圍內
blocks.en: The scope of special process validation under 7.5.6 is broad: it covers sterilization, aseptic filling, welding, sealing, and other processes whose output cannot be fully verified; process computer software also falls within this requirement

blocks.zh: 7.5.7 滅菌驗證有明確的再驗證觸發條件：產品、製程、設備、設施任何相關變更均可能觸發，CDMO 的變更管制程序必須包含滅菌影響評估步驟
blocks.en: Sterilization validation under 7.5.7 has clear revalidation triggers: any relevant change to product, process, equipment, or facility may trigger revalidation, and the CDMO's change control procedure must include a step for assessing the impact on sterilization

blocks.zh: 7.5.9 植入式器材的追溯要求遠強於一般產品：環境條件記錄、配送商記錄、收件人記錄均需保存；UDI 已成為主要市場的強制要求
blocks.en: The traceability requirements for implantable devices under 7.5.9 are far stronger than for general products: records of environmental conditions, distributors, and recipients must all be retained; UDI has become a mandatory requirement in major markets

blocks.zh: 7.6 校正失效的回溯評估是高風險義務：設備超出容許誤差必須觸發受影響批次調查；監控用軟體（LIMS、EM 系統）需要在使用前及變更後驗證
blocks.en: Assessing previous results after a calibration failure under 7.6 is a high-risk obligation: equipment found out of tolerance must trigger an investigation of the affected batches; monitoring software (LIMS, EM systems) must be validated before use and after changes
